entities.summary: Marie Lindberg is a Swedish schoolteacher, singer/songwriter and guitarist. She competed in the Swedish Melodifestivalen 2007 after sending in a song to the contest for fun. In Gothenburg on 10 February 2007, Lindberg, performing Trying to Recall, was the second artist named as a finalist in Melodifestivalen 2007.
